name: account-password-change-proof-replaced

graded_by.test: owed: Provider pauses own change after proving current hash A. A competing password write installs B before it resumes. Resumed own change must never replace B using proof against A: replace only the exact hash proved, with state check and write in one bbolt write transaction. Provider may reject or re-prove against current state; this fixture prescribes no response status for that race.
